# PlotTrellis paper example. Mouse mammary basal cells (Basal) and luminal progenitors (LP)
# from Milevskiy et al. 2023, Cell Genomics (GEO GSE227750), every data type, cut down to five
# genes (mm39): Eya2, Lrrfip1, Acot7, Dzip1 and Cxcl14. See README for the source of each file.
# data_root: .
# gtf_path: annotation.gtf.gz
# orgdb: org.Mm.eg.db
# genome_label: mm39
# start_gene: Eya2
# start_tracks: genes, transcripts_annotated, RNA, junctions, transcript_expression, ATAC, ATAC_peaks, H3K36me3, HiC
# start_comparison: Basal, LP
condition	colour	bw:RNA	paired-end:junctions	quantdir:salmon	bw:ATAC	bed:ATAC_peaks	bw:H3K36me3	bed:H3K36me3_peaks	bw:IgG	hic:HiC
Basal	#b31e1e	rna/Basal_RNA.bw	rna/Basal_junctions.bed	rna/Basal_salmon	atac/Basal_ATAC.bw	atac/Basal_ATAC_peaks.narrowPeak	cuttag/Basal_H3K36me3.bw	cuttag/Basal_H3K36me3_peaks.broadPeak	cuttag/Basal_IgG.bw	hic/Basal_HiC.mcool
LP	#4b7538	rna/LP_RNA.bw	rna/LP_junctions.bed	rna/LP_salmon	atac/LP_ATAC.bw	atac/LP_ATAC_peaks.narrowPeak	cuttag/LP_H3K36me3.bw	cuttag/LP_H3K36me3_peaks.broadPeak	cuttag/LP_IgG.bw	hic/LP_HiC.mcool
